data.description:
## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-4: The Phase-I closure check on this epic asserts both conditions above and blocks epic close if either fails

Create plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh — a closure-check script invoked directly by the sprint Phase-I orchestrator (no project_closure_hooks registration; preserves the default SC9/SC13/SC14 gate path for other epics). The script MUST emit a P1 typed-enum JSON verdict to stdout consumable by plugins/dso/scripts/check-verifier-verdict.sh:

  {"schema_version": 2, "P1": "PASS" | "FAIL", "criteria_results": [{"id": "...", "status": "PASS"|"FAIL", "detail": "..."}, ...], "closure_reason": "<one-line summary>"}

Checks:
  (a) .claude/scripts/dso ticket list --type=bug --parent=a34c-b345-1e63-4ae3 returns at least one bug with a detected_by:<channel> tag matching the seven allowed values
  (b) tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json exists and contains at least one entry with a detected_by:<channel> tag

Both checks must pass for P1=PASS; either failing yields P1=FAIL with relevant criterion marked FAIL. Script exits 0 always (verifier reads stdout JSON). Downstream gate: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh | bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-verifier-verdict.sh

Create RED test tests/scripts/test-check-a34c-closure.sh covering three scenarios:
  1. Happy path: fixture present + tagged bug exists → P1=PASS, pipe exits 0
  2. Missing fixture: fixture absent → P1=FAIL, pipe exits non-zero
  3. Missing tagged bug: fixture present but no bug has detected_by tag → P1=FAIL, pipe exits non-zero
Use mktemp dirs and a PATH-prepended dso stub so the test runs deterministically without touching real tickets.

## Testing Mode
RED — write the three-scenario test first; they fail because the script does not exist. Then implement the script.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Closure-check script exists and is executable — Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh
- Script emits JSON with required fields — Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh | jq -e 'has("schema_version") and has("P1") and has("criteria_results") and has("closure_reason")'
- P1 is one of PASS or FAIL — Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh | jq -e '.P1 | test("^(PASS|FAIL)$")'
- Happy path: pipe to check-verifier-verdict.sh exits 0 when conditions hold — Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh | bash plugins/dso/scripts/check-verifier-verdict.sh
- All three failure scenarios covered by test — Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-check-a34c-closure.sh
- Test file is executable — Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-check-a34c-closure.sh
- ShellCheck passes on both scripts — Verify: shellcheck plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh && shellcheck tests/scripts/test-check-a34c-closure.sh
- Does NOT add project_closure_hooks to dso-config.conf — Verify: ! grep -q 'project_closure_hooks' .claude/dso-config.conf

## File Impact
- plugins/dso/scripts/check-a34c-closure.sh — Create
- tests/scripts/test-check-a34c-closure.sh — Create
